name: quanto-promo
description: Promo b-roll for Quanto. The city is rebuilt natively in Remotion from the game's own isometric projection and real Chainlink prices.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts QuantoPromo out/quanto.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/index.ts QuantoPromoSquare out/quanto-square.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:landscape: node scripts/gen-audio.mjs landscape && remotion render src/index.ts QuantoLandscape out/quanto-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
